newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firm plans to buy 20,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firm plans to buy 20,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: A Philippine flour mill is planning to buy 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat if the price falls below $4 a bushel, Manila traders said on Thursday.
Traders said the milling company invited tenders for 20,000 tonnes of combined spring and western white wheat.

"The company is looking at the price and will likely buy if it softens below $4 a bushel excluding freight cost. They believe prices will drop because there's an oversupply of wheat in the world market," the traders added.
The company wants to buy wheat for late November shipment, they said.
